items.titleEn: In a recent interview, he said that AI-era big data needs to be used by different groups of mathematicians to drive technology development.
items.summaryEn: The Asian Mathematical Union was founded in Hong Kong, led by the renowned mathematician Chu Cheng, winner of one of the most prestigious prizes in international mathematics. He said he would seek to incorporate Hong Kong's River Park into the Union, as it is located across the river from Shenzhen Park, which has a good scientific research base. The Asian Mathematical Union will invite 25 senior mathematicians, 30 young scholars to regularly interact and recruit 100 post-doctoral students for mathematical research, most of which will be awarded to graduate students from Asia, and 20 will be reserved for graduate students in the Americas, Europe, Latin America and Africa. items.title: 消息：明年1月中電電費按年加1.8% 港燈按年加7.9%
items.summary: 消息指，兩間電力公司明年1月將加電費，中電按年加1.8%，港燈按年加7.9%。 兩電代表將於下午的立法會環境事務委員會會議上，交代明年周年電費檢討。 本港電費由兩個主要部分組成，即基本電費和燃料價條款收費。在本月，中電平均淨電價為每度電148.6仙，較今年1月上調約5.7%。至於港燈方面，11月的淨電價為每度電183仙，較今年1月上升約12%。 換言之，兩電明年1月的淨電價加幅的百分點，較今年11月為低。 編輯：譚佩貞
items.titleEn: News: China's electricity bills increase by 1.8% year-on-year in January next year, and port lights increase by 7.9% year-on.
items.summaryEn: According to reports, the two electricity companies will increase their electricity bills in January next year, with electricity in China increasing by 1.8% per year and port lights by 7.9% per year. The two representatives will discuss the next year's anniversary of electricity bills in the afternoon's meeting of the Environmental Affairs Committee of the Legislative Assembly. The electricity bill in Hokkaido consists of two main parts: the basic electricity bill and the fuel bill. The average net electricity price in China this month was 148.6 cents per unit of electricity, up about 5.7% from January this year. As for port lights, the net electricity price in November was 183 cents per electricity, up about 12% from January this year. In other words, the net electricity price increase in January of next year is a percentage point lower than in November of this year. Editor's note: She is a writer.

items.titleEn: Chen Mabo's delegation visited Cambridge, UK, to invite research institutions and businesses to consider setting up offices in the port
items.summaryEn: In a statement, the finance minister, Chen Mabo, led the Hong Kong delegation for business and innovation to visit Cambridge, UK. Chen Maupo met with the University of Cambridge and the two sides discussed further strengthening cooperation between Hong Kong and Cambridge University on research, talent development and the transformation of research outcomes. Chen Mobo presented the latest developments in Hong Kong's innovation and the development of the University City in the northern metropolitan area, and welcomed the University of Cambridge's strengthening of ties and research collaboration with universities and research institutions in Hong Kong. items.titleEn: Last month, about 5.13 million passengers visited the port, up 12% from almost 46 million in October.
items.summaryEn: According to the Bureau of Shipping, about 5.13 million passengers visited the port in early October, a 12% year-on-year increase. The number of domestic passengers increased by 15% to 3.97 million, and long-haul passengers by 19%. The Indian market has benefited from the long weekend holidays in the area, which have led to a significant increase in tourism, coupled with the exhibition activities in Hong Kong and the Bay Area. The number of short-haul passengers decreased by 14% year on year. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 私隱公署稱本港資料外洩事故通報增加 籲機構採取資料保安措施
items.summary: 個人資料私隱專員公署表示，近期環球網絡攻擊風險加劇，香港的資料外洩事故通報數目有所增加，受影響行業由航空及電器零售業擴展至其他零售及金融等多個行業。公署提醒所有機構，不論規模或行業均應未雨綢繆，提高網絡安全意識，定期檢視數據保安系統，進行資料保安風險評估，並適時採取資料保安措施，加強數據安全及防範資訊系統遭受惡意攻擊。…
items.titleEn: Privacy Authority says there has been an increase in reports of data breaches in Hong Kong, calling on the agency to take data security measures
items.summaryEn: The Office of Personnel Privacy Specialists said that recent global cyberattacks have increased, and the number of data breaches reported in Hong Kong has increased, with the affected industries expanding from aviation and electronics retail to other retail and financial sectors. The Public Prosecutor's Office reminds all agencies, regardless of their size or industry, to keep up-to-date, raise awareness of cybersecurity, regularly inspect data security systems, conduct data security risk assessments, and take timely data security measures to strengthen data security and prevent malicious attacks on information systems. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 曾巧峰獲委任為東區醫院行政總監 下月1日履新
items.summary: 醫管局公布委任曾巧峰為東區尤德醫院行政總監，下月1日履新。 曾巧峰是心胸外科專科醫生，並取得香港社會醫學學院行政醫學院士資格。她是一名資深高級行政人員，曾在醫管局總辦事處多個部門及聯網擔任不同的管理職位，具備廣泛經驗。現職葛量洪醫院、東華醫院及黃竹坑醫院行政總監。 曾巧峰積極參與醫院及聯網層面的工作，包括領導葛量洪醫院及東華醫院的服務定位與規劃，以及在香港島醫院聯網統籌制訂聯網的臨床服務計劃。 編輯：譚佩貞
items.titleEn: Chopin was appointed as the director of the Eastern District Hospital on 1st of the following month
items.summaryEn: The Medical Administration has announced that Chopin will be appointed as the Executive Director of the East District Yude Hospital on 1st of next month. Chopin is a former cardiothoracic surgeon and a graduate of the Faculty of Administrative Medicine at the Hong Kong School of Social Medicine. She is a senior senior executive with extensive experience in various management roles in various departments and on the Internet at the General Office of Medical Administration. He is currently the executive director of the Guangzhou Hong Hospital, Tongzhou Hospital and Yellow Bamboo Crater Hospital. Chopin has been actively involved in hospital and network work, including leading the positioning and planning of services at Guangzhou Hong Kong Hospital and Dong China Hospital, and coordinating the clinical services project for the network at Hong Kong Island Hospital. Editor's note: She is a writer.

items.titleEn: A food company known for its illegal import of workers has been subject to administrative sanctions by the Ministry of Labour
items.summaryEn: The Ministry of Labour announced that it had imposed administrative sanctions on the company, suspended the processing of the "Supplementary Workers' Optimization Program" import applications submitted by the company, and refused to process the applications submitted by it a year later under the "Suplementary Workership Optimization Plan". A spokesperson said that after an investigation, it was determined that the company did not continue to meet the requirement of a two-to-one ratio between full-time local employees and imported workers after the introduction of the labour market improvement plan, in violation of the regulations imposed by the administrative sanctions.
